critical_code_review_comments: Review request mentioned data-testid 'service-quote-a2z-plant-dynamic' but the actual implementation uses per-slug testids (service-quote-epc-landscaping, service-quote-large-scale-plantation, etc.). Company Profile modal does not have role='dialog' / aria-modal — minor a11y improvement recommended (Radix Dialog would provide this automatically).
